verdict.rationale: Luma's legacy Dream Machine API reference embeds per-endpoint OpenAPI 3.1.0 definitions in the markdown mirror of each reference page, indexed by llms.txt. That gives agents machine-readable spec content, but only in fragments. There is no standalone downloadable spec file: probes of openapi.json, swagger.json and well-known paths all return 404. The OpenAPI content also covers only the legacy generation, not the current Luma Agents API. Missing for 10: a single downloadable OpenAPI/equivalent spec file, spec coverage for the current Luma Agents API, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
